message.content: I usually wake up around seven, maybe a bit later if I’ve had a rough night. I make a cup of tea and toast, then feed the cat before getting dressed. I take the bus to work, so I leave the house just after eight. My sister and I live together, so she’s usually up too, but she’s got her own routine. I walk to the bus stop, then ride the bus for about twenty minutes. I work part time in the bookshop, so I don’t have a lot of responsibilities. I just open the shop with a colleague and start arranging the books. I like the quiet of the morning, it helps me focus. Sometimes, though, I hear a voice when I’m alone, but I try not to let it bother me too much.
